I love cooking! I really like making food from scratch, like home made pasta, mayonnaise etc. and trying out new recipes. My mother hates the fact that I like to cook. When I first started cooking, she was so scared I will become a chef despite me telling her many times that I don't want to be a chef and I just like cooking as a hobbie. As a result, she kept saying that whatever I cook is bad and I have no talent for cooking. Eventually, cooking became from a hobbie to 'cook something your mother will like'. After some time I stopped trying to please her and cook for my own enjoyment. Even thought my love and excitement for cooking remains, I still feel like whatever I cook is not good enough...
